result.reason: The Company’s 30-day notice period meets the preferred customer notice window, and retaining HDI’s 90-day period does not burden the Company. However, the operative language includes neither the required 60-day renewal reminder nor any cap on renewal price increases. It therefore fails the preferred position and, because it lacks the fallback cap of 5%, also fails the fallback. The changes are otherwise limited and preserve the one-year renewal structure, though the clause continues to frame notice as termination rather than expressly as non-renewal and should use “days’ written notice.”
